text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P0 - redwood-inference-api canary failure rate spike detected in us-west-2. Alert detail: canary_failure_rate > 5% over 5m. Triggered policy: canary-health-checks. PD:INC-9876

alice.k: seeing same in console. Canary traffic fraction at 5% for the new release. Errors look like 502/timeout pairs from edge-proxy -> embedder service.

ben.p: filing quick note: rolling deploy finished ~10m ago. Canary fraction increased to 0.05 at 4378901000.

charlie.r: oncall? requesting ack from primary. If not acked in 2m we auto-escalate.

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-9876 acknowledged by alice.k :white_check_mark:

alice.k: acked. quick triage: spikes correspond to requests that hit the new rate-limiter middleware. Logs show sudden 429s then retries -> upstream timeouts.

dana.m: copying logs snippet: ```
[2024-11-22T21:01:33Z] rate_limiter: key=canary-xyz allow=false burst=0 wait_time_ms=1200
[2024-11-22T21:01:33Z] proxy: upstream_timeout host=embedder-01.us-west-2 504
```

oncall-sre: tagging for handoff, I'm 10m into rotation. If this is a config flip we can toggle canary fraction back to 0 and cut traffic.

alice.k: agree. mitigation plan: 1) reduce canary fraction to 0. 2) disable new rate-limiter flag in canary routing. 3) monitor error rate and customer impact.

ben.p: preparing a rollback as precaution. Note: this release touched kernel quantization path and a new rate-limiter integration. We suspect rate-limiter mis-evaluating token costs causing negative budgets -> mass 429s.

charlie.r: can we route canary traffic to a fallback model variant instead of full rollback? That preserves some rollout momentum but avoids the failing middleware.

alice.k: good idea. I can update traffic-split to route canary -> model-v2-safe and keep default route to stable. Executing now.

alice.k: /deployctl set-traffic redwood-inference-api canary_fraction=0 now.

incident-bot: Deploy controller: traffic change accepted (change-id 8b3f). Canary fraction now 0.

pd-bot: INC-9876 note: action taken - reduced canary fraction to 0 by alice.k

dana.m: watching metrics: error rate for canary pool drops within 60s, p95 latency recovers from 2.3s -> 320ms. No evidence of broader region impact.

oncall-sre: good. Customer impact? Any external-facing incidents reported?

eve.l: Support reported 3 customer tickets with elevated latencies in the last 15m, all from edge-us-west-2, most were on free-tier hosted API. No major enterprise customers flagged so far.

ben.p: marking customer-impact: "partial, low-severity, limited to canary cohort and small subset of hosted calls". Recommend follow-up: revert rate-limiter config in canary branch and re-run unit tests for token-cost calc.

charlie.r: I'll open an eval suite run focused on throughput for rate-limiter integration.

alice.k: moving to rollback plan if errors reappear. For now status: mitigated (canary traffic removed).

pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9876 set to resolved by alice.k? Note: auto-resolve requires 30m stable.

oncall-sre: handing to eve.l for postmortem and root-cause investigation. Eve, can you take onwrite for RCA?

eve.l: taking. I'll collect logs, diffs for the rate-limiter commit, and schedule a postmortem sync in #postmortems. Preliminary hypothesis: rate-limiter token estimator undercounts for some request shapes leading to rapid denial and retries.

dana.m: saved command dump and current flags: ```
deployctl get-config redwood-inference-api --env=canary
# rate_limiter.enabled=true
# rate_limiter.token_estimator=fast-path
```

alice.k: follow-ups: 1) revert token_estimator change in canary branch 2) add synthetic load test for token estimator >= 1M tokens/s scenario 3) notify support to update any affected customers with a brief status note.

eve.l: will own the RCA and action items. Leaving incident thread open for 1h then resolve if metrics stable. Thanks for fast response :thumbsup:

pd-bot: INC-9876 incident status: mitigated -> monitoring (alice.k).

incident-bot: Note: if any PD escalation triggers re-fire, this thread will be auto-notified.

alice.k: small post-note: enabling extra telemetry capture for embedder RPCs for the next 30m (trace-id capture). If anyone sees regressions tag me.

charlie.r: ack, will watch the eval run.

oncall-sre: closing handoff to eve.l for PM. If anything spikes reopen and escalate to SRE lead.

eve.l: creating postmortem draft and will ping eng and support for stakeholder notes.

pd-bot: INC-9876 updated: monitoring window started.

(reacts: :eyes: by eve.l, :thumbsup: by ben.p)
